summary: Reorder the existing local and Owner/Guest interfaces around Vibe and everyday controls, demote palette/status/live-data details, and clarify Animation Mix labels without changing scene IDs or runtime behavior.

owner_design_gate.selected_option: Vibe primary; scenes secondary under Animation Mix; collapsed color selector and System Info; compact local status; internet availability stays with live data.
owner_design_gate.approval_reference: Direct owner instructions in current Cart Upgrades task on 2026-10-11
owner_design_gate.note: Existing saved scene and color selections remain authoritative. No physical installation or visual acceptance is claimed.

expert_basis.native_capability: Use existing HTML details/summary disclosures, existing embedded Matrix page, Owner PWA, Guest page, and existing control handlers. No new frontend or component framework.
expert_basis.platform_guidance: Apple Human Interface Guidelines recommend 44×44 pt hit regions for iOS/iPadOS controls; WCAG 2.2 AA target-size minimum is 24×24 CSS px subject to spacing exceptions. Existing controls retain at least 44 px/pt-oriented hit areas and visible focus treatment.

scoped_evidence.approved_architecture_reference: Direct owner approval to adapt the existing embedded Matrix page, Owner PWA, and Guest page; no new framework, UI surface, command, dependency, or runtime architecture.
scoped_evidence.affected_subsystem: Firmware-embedded local Matrix control HTML, existing Owner PWA, existing Guest page.
evidence_sources: Existing Owner/Guest source: hbnf-final-controller/hbnf-cart.html, hbnf-cart-ui-v6.css, hbnf-cart-ui-v6.mjs, hbnf-cart-features.mjs, guest/hbnf-cart/index.html, guest/hbnf-cart/guest.js
scoped_evidence.compatibility: Retains all four existing scene IDs (course-flow, field-mix, hbnf-signature, quiet-cosmos), all 28-kernel behavior, Vibe and tune handlers, brightness, text/scoreboard overlays, pairing, guest authorization, command gates, and palette application/readback code. Scene default remains course-flow only when no saved selection exists. Palette palette-name reads are deferred until the Color options disclosure opens.
scoped_evidence.truth_boundary: The compact local badge indicates Matrix-local connectivity only. DDP or backend command acknowledgement is not presented as proof of physical AUX illumination. Guest service status is explicitly separate from local Matrix control status.
scoped_evidence.rollback_reference: Revert this scoped source change. No installed firmware, production service, router, device setting, pairing/security boundary, or release gate was changed.
scoped_evidence.limitation: This is source-only UX preparation. The currently installed R6 does not contain the embedded UI edits; no new firmware or Owner/Guest package was built or deployed. Screenshot-based physical owner acceptance remains outstanding.
